Record Class TurDslQueryRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.viglet.turing.sn.dsl.TurDslQueryRequest
public record TurDslQueryRequest(TurDslQuery query, Integer from, Integer size, List<Object> sort, Object source, TurDslQueryRequest.TurDslHighlight highlight, Map<String, TurDslAggregation> aggs, TurDslQuery postFilter, Double minScore, List<Object> searchAfter, TurDslQueryRequest.TurDslCollapse collapse, Map<String, TurDslQueryRequest.TurDslSuggest> suggest, List<TurDslQueryRequest.TurDslRescore> rescore, String timeout, Boolean explain, Map<String, TurDslQueryRequest.TurDslScriptField> scriptFields, List<Map<String,Double>> indicesBoost, Object trackTotalHits, List<String> storedFields, String scroll, Boolean profile, TurDslQueryRequest.TurDslPit pit, List<Object> docvalueFields, Boolean version, Boolean seqNoPrimaryTerm, String preference, String routing, String searchType, Integer terminateAfter) extends Record
Root request body for the Query DSL endpoint, following the Elasticsearch _search request format.

Example: 

{
  "query": { "match": { "title": "search text" } },
  "from": 0,
  "size": 10,
  "sort": [{ "date": "desc" }, "_score"],
  "_source": ["title", "description"],
  "highlight": { "fields": { "title": {}, "body": {} } },
  "aggs": { "by_category": { "terms": { "field": "category", "size": 10 } } }
}
Since:
2026.2.4
Author:
Alexandre Oliveira
